terms.summary: 90 minutes plus injury/stoppage time; extra time, penalty shootout and later disciplinary result changes excluded.

The ordinary soccer page explicitly uses first 45 minutes legal-time results. Explicit 45-minute injury-time wording occurs on separate otherSoccer/special-market sections and is not silently borrowed.
One displayed handicap receives the whole stake; two displayed adjacent handicaps receive half the stake on each leg. Source example is half-ball/one-ball.
Source FT/HT examples show a one-goal handicap and a one-goal win refund both sides; do not treat this as evidence for arbitrary percentage suffixes.
Total goals exactly equal to the displayed total line refund the stake in full.
First-half total goals exactly equal to the displayed total line refund the stake in full.
Column-aligned official conversion table maps the football labels to baseball-style credit display. Numeric quarter-line notation is a derived representation of the source football labels.

Ordinary football text voids/refunds games terminated before legal 90 minutes, postponed more than 12 hours from original scheduled time, or cancelled. Youth 60–80-minute legal-length exception is separate and should not be applied to EPL/UCL. Details of a resumed suspended game, result reversal and a completed HT followed by abandoned FT remain scope-sensitive.
Ordinary HT text cancels all HT trades when that first half is cancelled/interrupted. Does not explicitly resolve finished HT followed by later FT abandonment against general all-football void text.
Current app retains user-confirmed 1% of total principal. Public rule source capture does not independently establish the rate/basis for this member account.

No public source evidence identifies eligible win/loss/half-win/half-loss/push/void/cancelled states, or whether partial settled versus returned principal counts. Do not derive this from total-principal basis alone.

Football handicap-parlay section incorrectly refers to five innings. This is a parlay-specific source defect; it does not invalidate separately supported ordinary single-bet FT/HT handicap/total clauses.

limitations: Public source collection is not an account-specific full contract.
The confirmed 1% total-principal rebate has separate user-instruction provenance; eligible settlement states are not present in the captured public rules.
Ordinary soccer HT explicitly states the first 45 legal minutes; injury-time wording on otherSoccer is retained as a distinct scope.
Parlay wording defects do not erase separately supported single-bet FT/HT clauses.
Original third-party assets and full text extraction are local audit evidence and are not republished in the repository.
